newsitem.title: USA: Sioux Falls cattle off $0.50-1.00 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Sioux Falls cattle off $0.50-1.00 - USDA.

text.p: USDA said slaughter steers and heifers were slow. Both classes were weak to $0.50 lower, instances $1.00 lower.
Steers - load and part load choice 3 Blacks 1400-1425 lbs 67.50-68.25. High select and choice 2-3 1200-1400 lbs 65.50-67.00. Select and choice 2-3 1100-1300 lbs 63.50-65.50.
Heifers - high select and choice 2-3 1025-1200 lbs
65.00-66.50 in a narrow test. Select and choice 2-3 1000-1125 lbs 63.00-65.00. Select 1-2 61.00-63.00.
